name: Mind Crier
body:
Aura faint abjuration; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of mind shielding. Instead of being shielded, however, the wearer broadcasts her thoughts to all creatures within 50 feet. The wearer suffers a -10 penalty to Stealth checks as a result. All creatures within 50 feet of the wearer must make a Will DC 15 save or be distracted by the wearer’s thoughts.

Any creature within 50 feet of the wearer who fails their Will save must make a concentration check to successfully cast any spell due to the distraction created by the wearer’s thoughts. Other Int and Wis-based skill checks are made at a -2 penalty.

Any creatures attacking the wearer gains a +2 insight bonus to attacks made against the wearer and a +2 insight bonus to their AC from the wearer revealing their movements and attacks.

Additionally, the wearer suffers a -10 penalty to saves versus mind affecting spells and effects. Any being within 10 feet of the wearer must also make a Will save (at the DC for the spell cast upon the wearer) or be dazed for 1 round.

Casting remove curse upon the ring allows the wearer to remove it, though the enchantment remains intact.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of mind shielding

Identification DC 28
False Identification DC 18
